list_cap.because: every list of the tool's answer that grows with the model stops at ten names and counts the rest (metrics_render.ANSWER_LIST_CAP)

page_rows.because: the profile's long-list rule: the number, then the first twenty; a model past it is one whose per-component answer would not be bounded

host_spill_bytes.because: VS Code spills an answer larger than 8 192 bytes to a file (measured 2026-10-23)

expectations.because: the precondition: the bench has far more components than a page, so an answer that grew with them would show it
the answer is about this model: its components, counted off the files by the locator
the directed dependencies of the bench, each pair once, counted off the files
the answer's size is bounded by constants, not by the model, and stays under the host's spill bound on the large bench
no per-component row, the part of an answer that grows with the model
no table per composition, whose size is not bounded by a constant
